Health Department Offers Flu Vaccines

RIVERTON – The district health department is reminding residents that seasonal flu vaccines are now available at every county health office in the district.

Standard and high-dose vaccines are offered. Most insurance plans are accepted, and self-pay pricing is posted at each office. Residents are encouraged to call ahead because high-dose supplies may be limited during the first weeks of the season.

“Getting vaccinated before flu activity peaks is the best way to protect yourself and your neighbors,” the district health director said.
